scope: Simple pair bench (original with hook off vs candidate with hook on), 10368 isolated CPU pairs for the 10 functions, zero differences, natural completion event with state_restored and layout_ok, saves unchanged, configs restored. Fake objects with 32-byte guards (rope 0x328 bytes, truck 0x99C bytes, 5 entities of 0xA40 bytes with a fake vtable, 6 matrices, 3 fake model infos/colmodels/collision data); full content (rope and truck byte by byte, the rest by hash), guards, return value, x87 control word and the outgoing call trace with arguments are compared. Traced stubs, patched at the EXE address and at the DLL body, so these helpers get NO credit: CEntity::RegisterReference, CPhysical::AddToMovingList, CWorld::Add/Remove, CObject::operator new (fixed buffer) and CObject(int32,bool), DefinedState, CCamera::IsSphereVisible, RwRenderStateSet, RwIm3DTransform/RenderIndexedPrimitive/End, CAutomobile::CAutomobile, CMonsterTruck::SetupSuspensionLines, CAutomobile::PreRender, CVehicleModelInfo::GetWheelPosn, CVehicle::SetTransmissionRotation/SetComponentRotation, CCollision::ProcessColModels and CPhysical::AddCollisionRecord (only the own part of each function is validated). Entities always carry a non-null matrix (a null one would allocate from the pool); fixture NaNs are quiet and floats copied with x87 are finite (no signalling NaN); no pool, file or real operator new/delete is touched. Excluded: CObject pool full (operator new returns null, EXE and DLL both dereference it); Remove and ReleasePickedUpObject with null m_pAttachedEntity and an attached object (the EXE dereferences null); CreateHookObjectForRope with m_pAttachedEntity != null is only tested as an early exit. Source corrected to what the EXE does before this run: CRope::PickUpObject (RegisterReference on &m_pRopeAttachObject and position through operator* 0x59C890), CRope::CreateHookObjectForRope (types 0 and >=8 return without creating), CRope::Render (NaN in distance and the table at 0x8CD818), CMonsterTruck::ProcessEntityCollision (jump on NaN and SetEntityReference without clearing the previous one). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation.
